minimumRealmSequence: From the main menu, open Campaigns and realms, then World conquest and diplomacy. Set Conquest faction to Deepforge (dwarves) and click Create realm.

Click Attack: Deep Gate Quarry. Use ordinary movement, attack, abilities and any real reinforcement commands to win. Confirm accepted quarry ownership, turn1, active:null, real survivors and Crossroads accessibility before diplomacy.

While the completed quarry scene remains installed, open Missions and realms → World conquest and diplomacy. Select Foreign faction Wild Court (fairies). Set Tribute ore to250 and click Offer tribute; observe accepted treasury/score change. Set Truce turns to2, click Request truce, and observe the temporary truce before clicking Request alliance.

After those decisions, use Saves → Export save to download ordinary SessionFile A, then Missions and realms → World conquest and diplomacy → Export realm profile to download B. Both must precede completed realm import/resume, which retires the battlefield. A.scenarioProfile.profile and B now contain the same capture and diplomacy history.

Use Load realm profile / Import realm profile to import B through the native file input. Reload the page. From Campaigns and realms → World conquest and diplomacy, click Resume saved realm and export restored profile C.

From the restored realm, click Attack: Brass Crossroads and fight using ordinary commands. Export active ordinary SessionFile D through Saves → Export save. Its owner and active journal establish continued deployment into the connected next battle.
